records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Partners!
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:1203da2c] - the only contact on record. Silent, fully inactive accounts rarely self-start in the remaining 8 days, though Starter setup is low-effort, so not negligible.

draft.subject: A simple first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Checking in since your Wrenfield account went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
